k1_clear_vs_cie.observed: sun 30 deg: median 0.054, worst 0.395 over 400 directions; sun 60 deg: median 0.108, worst 0.279 (bounds 0.25, 0.80). The Preetham transcription agrees with the independent CIE clear sky as two clear-sky fits should.

k3_turbidity.observed: absolute luminance 10 degrees from the sun rises from turbidity 2 to 6 (33,826 nits at 6). The first form, relative to the zenith, failed (4.705 at T 2, 2.271 at T 6): my check was wrong, the model was not; see addendum A.

k5_bake.observed: horizontal illuminance, cube against direct integration: clear noon 27,578 against 27,574 lux, overcast 19,550 against 19,548, golden hour 9,549 against 9,547 (all under 0.03%); night not integrated (artistic)

k6_lockfile.observed: evidence/envmaps.lock.json holds both families; the test checks 4 of 4 analytic skies on GCC and on MSVC. Overcast and night hash the same on both; clear noon, golden hour and the probe differ (acos, exp, tan, and the path tracer's sin and cos).

k7_relight.observed: evidence/envmaps/relight-sheet.png: the material gallery and the sphere field under clear noon, overcast, golden hour, night and the interior probe, with albedo, normal, roughness and depth. Every environment changes every asset; the night frames are auto-exposed to the sky's median, so they read bright, by choice of exposure. The first render kept the build-time sky in the background; fixed before this record.
